preflight_v15_diagnostic.failure: The forwarded-zero actuation outcome preceded delivery of the corresponding zero on the cached /cmd_vel subscription. One stale nonzero motion-history sample after the authoritative zero timestamp remained in every later all-since-zero window, so terminal_stop_verified stayed false even though the subsequent operational trajectory was stationary.

terminal_rest_window_amendment.scope: evidence lifecycle only; no detector, measurement, planner, controller, route, noise, threshold or statistical-design value changed
terminal_rest_window_amendment.rule: After an authoritative forwarded-zero outcome, the stationary evidence window begins after the last subsequently observed active /cmd_vel sample. A stale asynchronous sample therefore delays the window but cannot permanently poison all later stationary samples. The unchanged 0.25-s duration and 0.01-m maximum operational displacement requirements still apply.

preflight_release_gate.reference_alignment: own-time bounded interpolation of logged ground truth with max_reference_gap_s=0.15; highest explicit anchor revision per belief state timestamp
required: bootstrap evidence records one admitted camera plus declared start prior
goal reached without collision, timeout, stuck stop or integrity failure
ground-truth final goal distance at most 0.35 m

preflight_release_gate.failure_policy: Do not launch the final campaign unless every gate passes. Preserve failure and freeze another amendment before retrying.

prohibitions: Do not use any preflight as navigation comparison evidence.
Do not lower detector, image-border, hull, NIS, motion-support, route-support or clearance gates.
Do not use ground truth online.
Do not edit the reused V12 preflight or V9 final campaign configurations.
